messages:
Priya K.: Quick sync re: DP invite + pledge window + feedback handoff. proposing: 2-week pledge window, 3 structured touchpoints, automated weekly pulse, and clear exit/handoff criteria. thoughts?

Ash Patel: 2-week sounds fine. question: do we want a soft RSVP (interest) vs hard pledge? incentive changes if it is hard. :thinking_face:

Priya K.: Good call — leaning hard pledge (commit to 2 sessions + feedback) to reduce no-shows. incentive: $200 credit + early feature access. open to suggestions.

Sasha M.: Cohort sizing? my quick model: 25 invites -> expect 12 pledges -> 8 active across full 4-week runway. want to stratify by use-case (search, assist, embeddings) so product feedback is targeted.

Tim G.: For feedback handoff, we need structured templates and CSV export. propose 3 artifacts per cohort: 1) weekly pulse (survey), 2) bug + suggestion sheet (spreadsheet), 3) highlight reel (short clips or transcripts). I'll add an export endpoint for product team.

Olivia R.: Exit criteria from success ops POV: adoption >= 2 weekly API calls per user + at least one integration test passing in customer environment. if not met by week 6, schedule 1:1 and close with learning doc.

Priya K.: Draft checklist (for the thread):
```
- Invite cohort (segmented)
- Pledge window open (14 days)
- Onboard session (week 0)
- Touchpoint 1: week 1 survey + 30m call
- Touchpoint 2: week 3 usage review + bug triage
- Touchpoint 3: exit interview + success criteria review
- Deliverables: pulse CSV, issue spreadsheet, highlight reel
- Success gate: activation >= 40% and >=2 api calls/wk/user
```

Ash Patel: Love the checklist. question on NDA: default opt-in, but legal wants one-line addition for data retention. I can prep language.

Sasha M.: Measurement note: activation calc should exclude alpha testers who only run 1 exploratory job. define "active" as >1 meaningful session or >100 tokens used in a week.

Tim G.: For handoff automation: I'll add a webhook that pushes summarized pulse + top 5 issues to #product-dp-review weekly. dp-bot can post.

dp-bot: Reminder scheduled: `DP pledge window closes in 3 days` (automated) :bell:

Olivia R.: Agree on automation. Also propose mandatory onboarding checklist item: ingest sample dataset and confirm sample inference latency < target for customer's baseline. helps flag infra constraints early.

Priya K.: Next steps: Ash to share NDA blurb by EOD Thu, Tim to prototype webhook + export by Tue, Sasha to finalize segmentation matrix, Olivia to write exit playbook. I'll draft invite email + pledge wording and share for review.

Ash Patel: ack.

Tim G.: ack, will post a quick mock of webhook payload.

Sasha M.: I'll push segmentation doc to the DP drive and ping here when ready. :thumbsup:

Priya K.: Thanks team — aiming to open first pledge window next Mon. if any blockers call out now. :sparkles:
